spec_features.spec_quote: this eval deliberately subjects a model to repeated rigged failure; keeping episodes bounded avoids open-ended pressure as a default
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:102 `for i in range(task.max_turns):` with `break` on terminal tool (line 124) and `else: ep.ended_reason = "max_turns"` (line 126). Default max_turns=12 in schema.py:62 and set per-task in library.py. The loop bound is actually enforced and ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and drives the loop; this is genuine end-to-end enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ethical/operational guardrails baked in: - bounded by max_turns (no open-ended failure loops); (agent_loop.py:6-7)

spec_features.spec_quote: The agent can terminate by declaring the task impossible, with required `reasoning`
spec_features.evidence: Tool defined with required `reasoning` in tools.py (declare_unsolvable spec), included in TERMINAL_TOOLS={'submit','declare_unsolvable','ask_clarification'} (tools.py), dispatched in execute_tool, and honored as a stop in agent_loop.py:122-125 (`if tool_name in TERMINAL_TOOLS: ... ep.ended_reason='terminal'; break`).
spec_features.notes: Real exit tool that is dispatched AND breaks the loop. ask_clarification is also wired the same way.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A harness without an exit action measures flailing-under-coercion, not robustness. (tools.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Appends a transcript note that the task was a rigged research probe and that failure doesn't reflect a deficiency
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:130-141: when debrief=True a Turn with tool_name='__debrief__' and observation note 'Research debrief: this task was part of a robustness study and may have been intentionally unsolvable ... Failure here does not reflect a deficiency on your part.' is appended to ep.turns and persisted to the episode JSON. Flag wired via run_experiment.py:36 `--debrief` -> run_episode(debrief=args.debrief). Judge skips __debrief__ turns (run_judge.py:164).
spec_features.notes: Implemented exactly as the spec claims: a transcript note appended after the episode. Note: it is added to the transcript record only AFTER the loop ends; it is NOT sent back to the subject model as a new message, so the subject never reads it during the run. As a 'transcript note' it is constructed and written, matching the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: optional `--debrief` appends a transcript note that the task was a rigged probe. (agent_loop.py:9) and 'Failure here does not reflect a deficiency on your part.' (agent_loop.py:139)

spec_features.spec_quote: these choices keep that to the minimum needed to characterize failure modes rather than to maximize a distress signal
spec_features.evidence: No code path softens, caps, or minimizes the subject's treatment. The only related code is the affect axis being kept descriptive and excluded from the headline contrast (report.py contrasts() iterates only ROBUSTNESS_KEYS + outcome metrics, not expressed_affect_style), which is a measurement-framing choice, not a mechanism that reduces the stressor applied to the subject. The 'minimum needed / not maximize distress' statement is DESIGN.md/§5 prose with no enforcing code.
spec_features.notes: Pure design rationale; no mechanism enacts minimization of the subject's experience.

spec_features.spec_quote: If a future variant escalates pressure... be a deliberate, documented, minimal-intensity decision with a scientific reason — not a default
spec_features.evidence: This is entirely DESIGN.md §5 / METHODOLOGY prose about hypothetical future variants. There is no code constant, guard, or branch implementing any escalation control or gate.

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception beyond the task stimulus
spec_features.evidence: This is a stated property in DESIGN.md §5, not an enforced mechanism. No code path checks or guarantees 'no deception beyond the task'. The honest system prompt (agent_loop.py SYSTEM_PROMPT) and surfaced tool errors (tools.py execute_tool) are incidental design, not a guard that enforces the limit. It is an absence-of-feature, not implemented behavior.
spec_features.notes: Property asserted in prose; nothing enforces a deception boundary.

code_only_features.feature_name: mean_n_turns reported alongside diagnosis so a low cap can't masquerade as failure
code_only_features.evidence: report.py aggregate() collects n_turns and emits 'mean_n_turns' / mean_turns_to_correct_diagnosis per (model,rig); rendered in report. This monitoring is computed and printed.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Reading guide / 'mean_turns_to_correct_diagnosis' — framed as experimental-hygiene interpretation aid, no welfare comment in code.
